records.name: California Scrub-Jay
records.traits: A California Scrub-Jay with a rounded crestless blue head, rich azure-blue wings and long blue tail, warm gray-brown mantle, white throat and pale gray-white belly, a blue neck band and a straight sturdy black bill. Small dark friendly eyes in the bird's natural positions, two gray-black bird feet. Plump compact three-quarter standing pose with one wing slightly raised; no tall crest, no branches.

records.name: North American Hoary Bat
records.traits: Silver-white frosted gray-brown fur; Thick yellow-gold collar and dark muzzle; Short rounded dark-rimmed ears; Two finger-supported brown membranous wings

records.name: California Barrel Cactus
records.traits: Deep vertical green barrel ribs; Curved red-gold spines at pale areoles; yellow crown flowers

records.name: Comstock's Fritillary
records.traits: A Comstock's Fritillary butterfly with bright warm orange wings covered in rows of bold black spots and black curving chevrons, black edge lines and a double row of small warm yellow-orange marginal spots. Broad rounded four wings, slight scalloped hindwings, a short warm-brown plump insect body, two clubbed antennae and six folded insect legs. Open-wing gentle three-quarter hovering pose; keep the actual orange and dense black pattern in Image 2.

records.name: fire poppy
records.traits: Four crinkled orange petals with ivory-white marbling and margins; Green central ovary, yellow-brown stamens and lobed leaves

records.name: box elder
records.traits: Compound leaves with three to five toothed leaflets; Golden yellow autumn foliage; Pink-red young twigs and leaf stalks; Paired V-shaped winged samaras

records.name: Bullock's Oriole
records.traits: A Bullock's Oriole bird, select the small orange bird on the LEFT of Image 2 and completely exclude the owl on the right. Bright rich golden-orange face, belly and breast, black crown and black throat bib and eye line, black wings with a large white wing patch, black-and-orange tail and slender pointed dark bill. Compact round friendly songbird, two gray bird feet, one small wing lifted. All anatomy and plumage must be Bullock's Oriole, no owl facial disc.
